regime_montecarlo_decision.summary: A three-state hidden Markov model (flat, uptrend, downtrend) reads ADX, candle bodies, range compression, confirmed swing highs and lows and higher-high / higher-low structure and tracks the current regime bar by bar; a Monte Carlo simulation runs the current regime forward; Kronos forecasts the next candles; FinBERT reads the news; gradient-boosted trees weigh all four and decide whether to trade.
regime_montecarlo_decision.implementationNote: Regime model: cycle/regime_hmm.py StructuralRegimeHMM (docs/regime-hmm.md), exactly three states named and ordered flat, uptrend, downtrend, over eight causal features: Wilder ADX 14, the 14-bar mean candle body-to-range ratio, 14-bar over 100-bar mean true range, the close's distance from the last swing high and low confirmed swing_confirmation_bars bars after it formed (shared.zones.structural_pivots) over the move scale, bars since the last pivot, a decayed higher-high / higher-low counter (half-life 48 bars) and the sign of the last two pivots. Diagonal Gaussian emissions over the features standardised on the training span; hmmlearn GaussianHMM Baum-Welch seeded from a heuristic labelling (flat where ADX < adx_threshold, else up / down by the counter's sign), transition diagonal initialised at 0.95 with a sticky Dirichlet prior, a variance floor and a Gaussian prior holding each state's mean near its seed after every iteration, up to regime_fit_iteration_count iterations, states ordered by the counter's mean; the walk uses the forward filter, never the smoother. Monte Carlo: per regime a Student-t of the one-bar log return (scipy maximum likelihood on the training bars the forward filter puts in it); simulation_count paths of the label horizon start from the filtered regime probabilities and re-draw the regime each bar from the transition matrix, with common random numbers. Kronos: the pretrained foundation model (kronos_model_size, pinned Hugging Face revision) reads the last kronos_context_bars candles and decodes the next horizon candles greedily. FinBERT: the nine finbert_* columns. Decision model: xgboost over the three regime probabilities, the simulation's P(up), expected move and 10-90 percentile spread, Kronos' move and direction and the FinBERT columns, the regime and simulation signals of the last maximum_training_bars training rows made out of fold (stacking_fold_count blocks, each purged by the label horizon on both sides), early-stopped on validation. The trade gate is a quantile gate: gate_open_fraction is the share of bars it should open on; the fold's absolute threshold is the (1 - gate_open_fraction) quantile of |P - 0.5| over the decision model's purged out-of-fold probabilities on the stacking rows, and the gate opens when |P - 0.5| is at or beyond it. The price model is the simulation's expected move. Expect: regimes describe trend and range well; direction is close to the base rate.
regime_montecarlo_decision.estimatedTrainingTime: 10-60 min (paced replay; Kronos reads every test bar on the GPU)

adx_threshold.label: ADX flat threshold
adx_threshold.description: Training bars whose average directional index (ADX 14) is below this seed the flat regime before Baum-Welch refines it; at or above it, the higher-high / higher-low score's sign seeds uptrend or downtrend.

swing_confirmation_bars.label: Swing confirmation (bars)
swing_confirmation_bars.description: A swing high is a bar whose high is above the highs of this many bars on each side (the mirror for a swing low), so a pivot is known only this many bars after it forms.

regime_fit_iteration_count.label: Regime fit iterations
regime_fit_iteration_count.description: Most Baum-Welch (expectation-maximisation) iterations of the structural hidden Markov model fit; it stops sooner when the log-likelihood gains less than 0.01.

simulation_count.label: Simulated paths
simulation_count.description: Monte Carlo paths of the label horizon simulated at every bar from the current regime probabilities.

kronos_model_size.label: Kronos model
kronos_model_size.description: Which pretrained Kronos forecasts the next candles: mini (4.1 million parameters, fastest), small (24.7 million) or base (102.3 million).

kronos_context_bars.label: Kronos context (bars)
kronos_context_bars.description: Candles ending at the bar that Kronos reads before it forecasts the next ones.

stacking_fold_count.label: Out-of-fold blocks
stacking_fold_count.description: Contiguous blocks the stacking rows are cut into; each block's regime and simulation signals come from a regime model fitted without it (purged by the label horizon).

maximum_training_bars.label: Stacking rows
maximum_training_bars.description: The most recent training rows the decision model is fitted on (each needs a Kronos forecast and a simulation).

boosting_rounds.label: Decision model boosting rounds
boosting_rounds.description: Most boosting rounds of the decision model (early stopping ends sooner when validation stops improving).

max_depth.label: Decision model tree depth
max_depth.description: Deepest split chain of each decision tree.

gate_open_fraction.label: Share of bars the trade gate opens on, most confident first
gate_open_fraction.description: The engine enters a trade only on the bars where the decision model's probability is furthest from 0.5. This is the share of bars that should qualify: at fit, the fold's threshold is the (1 - share) quantile of |P - 0.5| over the decision model's purged out-of-fold probabilities on the training rows. 1.0 opens the gate on every bar.
